GRADE 6 CREATIVE ARTS — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Time: 48 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Melody at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. sing the sol-fa syllables doh to doh1 ascending and descending,
   B. Learners should ignore Melody completely.
   C. Melody is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Melody.

2. About Melody at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. perform the sol-fa ladder using Kodaly hand signs,
   B. Learners should ignore Melody completely.
   C. Melody is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Melody.

3. About Melody when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. aurally recognise sol-fa sounds doh to doh1 in familiar melodies,
   B. Learners should ignore Melody completely.
   C. Melody is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Melody.

5. About Athletics at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe Long jump and High jump techniques in athletics,
   B. Learners should ignore Athletics completely.
   C. Athletics is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Athletics.

6. About Athletics at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. perform the sail technique in Long jump for skills acquisition,
   B. Learners should ignore Athletics completely.
   C. Athletics is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Athletics.

7. About Athletics when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. perform the scissors technique in High jump for skills acquisition,
   B. Learners should ignore Athletics completely.
   C. Athletics is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Athletics.

9. About Descant Recorder at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. play notes C to D1 on the descant recorder with appropriate playing techniques,
   B. Learners should ignore Descant Recorder completely.
   C. Descant Recorder is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Descant Recorder.

10. About Descant Recorder at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. play a melody within the range of C to D1on the descant recorder,
   B. Learners should ignore Descant Recorder completely.
   C. Descant Recorder is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Descant Recorder.

11. About Descant Recorder when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. play the main melody of the Kenya National Anthem on the descant recorder,
   B. Learners should ignore Descant Recorder completely.
   C. Descant Recorder is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Descant Recorder.

13. About Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the categories of indigenous Kenyan instrumental ensembles,
   B. Learners should ignore Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles completely.
   C. Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

14. About Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. describe factors to consider when playing in an instrumental ensemble,
   B. Learners should ignore Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles completely.
   C. Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

15. About Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. play a selected instrument in an ensemble using appropriate techniques,
   B. Learners should ignore Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles completely.
   C. Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

17. About Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify pottery items made using slab technique,
   B. Learners should ignore Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery completely.
   C. Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.

18. About Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. model a vase using slab technique for expression,
   B. Learners should ignore Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery completely.
   C. Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.

19. About Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. decorate a modelled item for aesthetic enhancement,
   B. Learners should ignore Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery completely.
   C. Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.

21. About Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre completely.
   C. Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.

22. About Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre completely.
   C. Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.

23. About Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre completely.
   C. Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Melody at home with your family.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Athletics at home with your family.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Descant Recorder at home with your family.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles at home with your family.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery at home with your family.

24. Give two examples of how you can use Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre at home with your family.
